**Wrote the 4.2.0 entry** in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).

380 commits reduced to 13 user-facing changes. The rest is dep bumps, tests, CI, and renames. Three of the changes are breaking, so `4.2.0` may need to be `5.0.0`.

| Change | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| v1 export route removed | Callers get a 404 |
| Internal error types unexported | Imports break |
| Expired token now `401`, was `403` | Re-auth logic breaks |

Two open items. `docs: note the minimum node version` and `ci: run the suite on node 22` may mean a Node floor bump. The log has no version number, so check the diff. Perf work sits in an HTML comment. Move it up if you want it seen.
